conviction_note: The fundamentals lean slightly up: outdoor is lapping the Warsaw bus-shelter concession and the AMS acquisitions, Q3 2025 carried a 2.7m PLN restructuring provision, and the summer film slate was strong. The reaction leans the other way: the stock is +48% since the Q2 2026 beat, which moved it 0.0% on the day, and it now trades above the only sourced target (BDM 12.08 PLN). With no sourced Q3 bar, p_up sits at 50 on a 5.5% unsigned move, so the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to 0.0 because they offset, not because they were fitted to it.

positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The KNF short register is unreadable from this container (403), so nothing is known about short interest in AGO, which is not the same as zero. priced_lean_pct (-0.27) is the 20-day run-up alone, which is also the free control. findings.finding: Outdoor (AMS) is the line that grew: Q2 2026 outdoor revenue rose almost 44% to ~92m PLN and EBITDA almost 63% to 45.1m. The Warsaw bus-shelter concession was signed in October 2025 and the AMS acquisition was negotiated from September 2025, so Q3 2026 also laps a Q3 2025 base without them, which points to a double-digit y/y group EBITDA gain over 58.3m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 print carried this line (EBITDA +23%, EBIT 26.7m against a ~19m preview) and the stock closed unchanged on the day (8.68 to 8.68), then rose ~48% over three months. The Q3 2025 beat moved +6.07% on the day.
findings.original_quote: Przychody segmentu Reklama Zewnętrzna w drugim kwartale 2026 r. wyniosły blisko 92 mln zł (translation: outdoor segment revenue in Q2 2026 was nearly 92m PLN)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 48% re-rating since the Q2 print is most plausibly the market catching up to this line. If it were fully priced, the stock would sit at a target built on it, and the only sourced target (BDM 12.08, 2026-09-03) is already below spot. What stays open is the size of the Q3 y/y step, because there is no Q3 consensus anywhere to anchor it, and the name has 1-2 covering analysts.
findings.independence: Concession dates: https://www.stockwatch.pl/komunikaty-spolek/agora,przedluzenie-umowy-koncesji-zawartej-pomiedzy-2026-08-11,espi,20260811_152446_0000355990 (refers to raport 21/2025 of 2025-10-06). Q3 2025 outdoor growth was only 13.6% (https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20251119/agora-w-iii-kw-miala-6-mln-zl-straty-netto-jd-oraz-583-mln-zl-zysku-ebitda).

findings.finding: Q3 2025 carried a 2.7m PLN restructuring provision in Digital and Print Press, and the January 2026 group layoffs plus the back-office merger with Agora TC (registered 2 Nov 2026) cut the cost base, so Q3 2026 EBIT laps a one-off-burdened base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction isolated to cost lines. Cost savings have been part of each beat since Q3 2025.
findings.original_quote: w tym 2,7 mln zł rezerwy restrukturyzacyjnej w segmencie Prasa Cyfrowa i Drukowana (as summarised from the article; translation: including a 2.7m PLN restructuring provision in the Digital and Print Press segment)
findings.why_not_priced: Small and mechanical. Anyone modelling Q3 y/y has it, and it is ~0.5% of market cap a quarter. It counts only because the bar is unsourced, so nobody can check that it is in the bar.
findings.independence: January 2026 layoffs: https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43662851-agora-sa-zawarcie-porozumien-w-sprawie-zwolnien-grupowych-w-spolkach-zaleznych ; merger rationale (cutting back-office costs): https://www.stockwatch.pl/komunikaty-spolek/agora,uzgodnienie-tresci-planu-polaczenia-z-agora-t-2026-09-07,espi,20260907_214946_0000357724

findings.finding: Helios had a strong summer slate in Q3 2026 after an H1 of falling attendance: Spider-Man: Brand New Day became the first superhero film above 2m Polish admissions, alongside The Odyssey (17 July) and Minions. Helios's CEO said in July that 'a series of hits' bodes well for H2 after H1 attendance fell ~3% (22.22m tickets).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cinema drove the Q3 2025 revenue beat ('the largest revenue growth came from cinema activity') and the stock rose 6.07% that day.
findings.original_quote: Dobrze wróży wynikom drugiego półrocza seria hitów, które jeden po drugim będą wchodzić na ekrany. (translation: a series of hits, opening one after another, bodes well for second-half results)
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy, not a company number: no Q3 2026 national admissions total and no Helios ticket count was found, and the Q3 2025 comparison base is unknown, so the market cannot have a precise number either. A management statement made before the quarter is only a hope.

findings.finding: The Polish ad market ran near inflation (~3%) in mid-2026 with TV clearly down, below Agora's own 2026 forecast of +5.5-7%. WP's CEO guided Q3 ad/subscription trends 'similar to H1', and Agora's Internet segment lost 6.0m EBIT in Q2. So radio and Internet are soft, and the release may trim Agora's market forecast.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Agora 'kept' its market forecast in Aug 2025 and May 2026. No observed cut and reaction to cite.
findings.original_quote: Mówi się o wzrostach wydatków reklamowych na poziomie zbliżonym do inflacji (translation: ad-spend growth is said to be running at roughly the level of inflation)
findings.why_not_priced: This is transmission from the market to the company, not a company number, and it is public. But the stock re-rated +48% while this backdrop was known, which suggests the price looks through radio and Internet softness. A cut to the forecast would be the visible new item, and none has been made since May.
findings.independence: WP CEO on Q3 trends (2026-09-09): https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45118221-prezes-wirtualnej-polski-ostrzegl-inwestorow ; Agora's 5.5-7% forecast: https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260522/agora-spodziewa-sie-dynamiki-wydatkow-na-reklame-w-polsce-w-26-na-poziomie-ok

findings.finding: The stock has re-rated from 8.68 PLN on the Q2 print day (2026-08-13) to 12.85 PLN (+48%) and now trades ~6% above the only sourced target, DM BDM's 12.08 PLN Buy of 2026-09-03 (issued at 9.18). lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' and 'size on what is new, history moves p_up': abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 5.5, because the quarter is fully new (no pre-release). I kept it below the 7% European base because there is no company guidance and the name's observed results-day moves have a ~2.8% median and a 6.1% maximum over 10 events.
Unsourced bar caps every finding: outdoor finding cut from +0.8 to +0.6, provision-lapping from +0.3 to +0.2.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series' / macro transmission is a hypothesis: cinema slate finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'The move is in the guide': the ad-market forecast item was kept as a guidance finding at -0.5, unchanged.
'Positioning is the thing to beat': the above-target finding agrees with the run-up lean, so it was kept small (-0.5) and not raised.
